description_en: Queries the execution records of a development stage in batches
description_zh: 批量查询研发阶段执行记录
kebab_example: aliyun devops list-app-release-stage-executions --app-name testApp --release-workflow-sn 340beb481a334fd49b006816382f0c11 --release-stage-sn e173f3c11db5445eb426ca33c92207c8 --api-version 2021-06-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAppReleaseStageExecutions

parameters.help_en: The pagination mode. A value of keyset indicates keyset pagination
parameters.help_zh: 分页模式参数：keyset表示键集分页
parameters.name: pagination

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页尺寸参数，决定一页最多返回多少对象，默认20，限制[1,100]
parameters.name: per_page

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the records. Default value: gmtCreate
parameters.help_zh: 分页排序属性，决定根据何种属性进行记录排序；默认 gmtCreate
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: asc (ascending order) and desc (descending order). Default value: desc
parameters.help_zh: 分页排序升降序，asc 为升序，desc 为降序；默认 desc
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en: The keyset pagination token. You do not need to specify this parameter when you query the first page. For subsequent pages, set this parameter to the nextToken value returned in the response of the previous request
parameters.help_zh: 键集分页 token，获取第一页数据时无需传入，否则需要传入前一页查询结果中的 nextToken 字段
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not required in keyset pagination mode
parameters.help_zh: 键集分页模式下不需要传入
parameters.name: page

current.description_en: The current page number. This field is returned only when page number pagination is used
current.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页
current.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页
current.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页

endTime.description_en: The end time of the pipeline execution. The time is in ISO 8601 format and includes a time zone offset
endTime.description_zh: 流水线执行结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式并包含时区偏移

startTime.description_en: The start time of the pipeline execution. The time is in ISO 8601 format and includes a time zone offset
startTime.description_zh: 流水线执行开始时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式并包含时区偏移

triggerMode.description_en: The trigger mode of the pipeline execution

nextToken.description_en: The keyset pagination token. This field is returned only when keyset pagination is used. Pass this value in the next request to retrieve the next page of data
nextToken.description_zh: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据
nextToken.title_en: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据
nextToken.title_zh: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据

pages.description_en: The total number of pages. This field is returned only when page number pagination is used
pages.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数
pages.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数
pages.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数

perPage.description_en: The number of entries per page. This field is returned only when page number pagination is used
perPage.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小
perPage.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小
perPage.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小

total.description_en: The total number of results. This field is returned only when page number pagination is used
total.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
total.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
total.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
